name: job-apply
description: AI-powered job application assistant for Claude Code and Codex covering LinkedIn, Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever, Rippling, and Workday.

interface.shortDescription: Fill applications without surrendering the final click

defaultPrompt: Fill this job application from my resume.
